var StudentLogin = Class.create();
StudentLogin.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    validateStudent: function() {

        var username = this.getParameter('sysparm_username');
        var password = this.getParameter('sysparm_password');

        var gr = new GlideRecord('student');
        gr.addQuery('number', username);
        gr.addQuery('password', password);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            return "success";
        } else {
            return "invalid";
        }

    }
